Class AnimatedEntity

java.lang.Object
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.entity.AnimatedEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Renderable, Comparable<Renderable>
public class AnimatedEntity extends Object implements Renderable
Represents an animated object in an isometric grid. Its position, orientation, and current animation frame determine how the object is rendered.

  • Constructor Details

    • AnimatedEntity

      public AnimatedEntity(AnimatedOrientedSprite sprite, Orientation orientation, int xPosition, int yPosition, int zPosition)
      Creates an animated view object with its shadow enabled when the sprite provides a shadow atlas. The rendering tie-break priority is fixed at 2.
      Parameters:
      sprite - animated sprite to draw
      orientation - sprite orientation
      xPosition - horizontal grid position
      yPosition - vertical grid position
      zPosition - height in grid levels

    • setAnimationSpeed

      public void setAnimationSpeed(double animationSpeed)
      Sets the animation playback speed. A value of 1.0 uses the normal animation speed. A value of 2.0 plays the animation twice as fast. A value of 0.5 plays the animation at half speed.
      Parameters:
      animationSpeed - a positive playback speed multiplier

    • setPosition

      public void setPosition(double x, double y, double z)
      Places the animated entity at an exact position in world coordinates. Positive X points east, positive Y points north, and positive Z is up. Changing position does not change orientation or restart the animation.
      Parameters:
      x - east-west position, in tile units
      y - north-south position, in tile units
      z - elevation, in world levels
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a coordinate is not finite
